list.$description: Tokens for List: bullet lists with AcmeCo's dark blue bullets, in columns (decision 50). Measured from the audit's capture of the retail property page's Highlights (desktop 1700px, phone 400px).

font-size.$description: OBSERVED: 20px items; became 18px, the nearest size on the scale, as FactList (decision 47).

color.$description: OBSERVED, LEGACY-NAMED: a dark blue dot (--legacy-color-brand, #123a7a), 10.98:1 on white. Decorative: the list itself tells screen readers each item is a point.

size.$description: OBSERVED: an 8px round dot, centred on the item's first line.

gap.$description: OBSERVED: the text starts 20px in (padding-left), 12px after the 8px dot.

item-gap.$description: OBSERVED: 15px under each item; became 16px (the 4px grid).

column-gap.$description: OBSERVED: 40px between the two lists; became 32px, the nearer step that keeps more of each line.
